title: Trim bar paints a solid slab when a clip has no waveform; GIF bar back to the 28px track
description: MPI-829 regression: with no wavePath the wave layer gets mask-image none, which UNMASKS it, so every silent video and every GIF shows a solid ink-4 block cap to cap. Hide the layer when there is no wave, and give the GIF bar its old 28px track.
